id: Mishneh Torah, Shofar, Sukkah and Lulav 2:4

q_practical: Can a minor's older brother manage the family field while the minor is missing?

id: Mishneh Torah, Admission into the Sanctuary 3:2

q_conceptual: Why does the person demanding payment always have to bring the proof?

id: Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 1:10

q_conceptual: Why isn't a farmer required to pay the poor the value of what he was supposed to leave them?

q_conceptual: Why does keeping ownership of trees automatically include keeping some of the land?

id: Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 1:3

q_conceptual: Why are festival prohibitions treated as one category instead of separate ones like on the Sabbath?

q_practical: Can I grow cotton between my grapevines?
q_conceptual: Why do some plants growing near grapevines get treated like consecrated produce and others don't?
